findings.title: Never add Co-Authored-By: Claude to commits or PRs
findings.message: The CHANGELOG.md contains `Co-Authored-By: Claude` and `Generated with Claude Code` trailers that must be removed. These trailers should not appear in commit messages or PR descriptions — the author of every commit is the human running the session.

claims.reason: The diff shows that CHANGELOG.md has been modified to add a new section (v0.4.1) that includes the line `Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>` at lines 10-11.

claims.claim: CHANGELOG.md contains `Generated with Claude Code` trailer
claims.reason: The diff shows that CHANGELOG.md has been modified to add the line `🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)` at line 12.

claims.claim: These trailers must be removed from CHANGELOG.md
claims.reason: The rule document explicitly states that commit messages, PR descriptions, and review comments must not contain `Co-Authored-By: Claude`, `Generated with Claude Code`, or any other AI-attribution trailer. The finding cites this rule and indicates these trailers should not appear. However, the diff shows these trailers being ADDED to CHANGELOG.md, not removed. The rule document does not specifically address whether CHANGELOG.md (as a documentation file) should follow this rule, but the finding asserts they must be removed.

claims.claim: The author of every commit is the human running the session
claims.reason: This statement is directly from the rule document, which states 'The author of every commit is the human running the session.' It is a principle underlying the rule.
